lines: Fine. I'll let the field lie quiet for now.
Fine. I'll set this down before it gets heavier.

All right. I am willing to let this cool down.
Fine. We can settle this without making it worse.

That is enough for me to step back.
I am still angry, but I do not want a fight.
We can speak again once both of us have clearer heads.
I will accept this and leave the matter here.
You came to make peace. I will not punish you for trying.
All right. Let us give the village one less problem today.
I believe you mean it. Do not prove me wrong.
This does not erase what happened, but it stops the damage here.
I can live with that. We are done for now.

We will call this settled and move forward carefully.
